newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES END STEADY IN BALANCED MARKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES END STEADY IN BALANCED MARKET.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates finished steady on Friday at 20.75 percent in a balanced market but moderate activity, traders said.
"It looks like most players already topped up their reserves on Thursday," said Istvan Horvath of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
Overnight rates have a tendency for rather hectic movements on the lasty day of the banks' two-week reserve period at the middle and end of each month.
Overnight rates moved in a range between 20.50 to 20.875 percent compared with Thursday's close of 20.75 percent.
Horvath added that he expected a balanced market with little movement either way on Monday, unless the central bank surprises the market on Friday with a repo rate cut.
Last time, The National Bank of Hungary cut its repo rates on a working Saturday when a number of banks were not on the market.
